# Charnock volume 1 retained-source evidence

This file accompanies a nonaccepted reconstruction candidate for *The Existence and Attributes of God, Vol. 1* from the exact retained Project Gutenberg eBook 53527 text. The retained witness is a “two volumes in one” transcription. Volume 1 body lines are represented separately; the combined index, footnotes, and transcriber notes are retained as explicitly shared edition apparatus. The Gutenberg wrapper, full license, and volume 2 body remain evidence-only for this route.
